summary: Listed in the Georgia lookout-tower list for Dooly County; no source found on its build, staffing, fate or present state.

evidence.supports: Lookout is listed under the name snow spring in Dooly County on the Georgia tower list.

notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms Georgia list (page dated 2016), which gives name, county, coordinates and a bare number 460 with no unit. The record's elevation_m 140.2 assumes feet; verify. Two web searches and reads of the Wikipedia article on Snow Spring, Georgia and of Vanishing Georgia tower pages found no tower history; the community article mentions no tower. No story written: the evidence is a single list entry, below the 120-word floor, and filling it would mean padding with community facts that are not about the tower. Next steps: Georgia Forestry Commission tower records, Dooly County historical society or Vienna library, historic USGS topographic maps of the site.
